title: </sub>  Give each repeated run its own pass deadline
text:
</sub>  Give each repeated run its own pass deadline

When a real-model campaign uses the prescribed `--runs 5`, the current `main` creates one `AbortController` and one `passTimeoutMs` timer for the entire invocation (`src/cli/recall-benchmark.ts:447-449`). Merely repeating the benchmark inside that structure means the aggregate duration of otherwise valid runs can expire the shared signal, aborting later samples and preventing the mandatory five-run evidence campaign. Specify that each iteration creates and disposes its own controller/timer so the existing pass timeout remains a per-pass limit.
